instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\bore_plate.step. Create drilling and bore/circular-pocket operations. Spot and drill the four through holes, breaking through the bottom by 1 mm, then machine the two stepped bore holes to bottom Z=9.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 90 degree spot drill, T2 is a through drill, and T3 is a bore/circular-pocket tool for the stepped bores. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-8.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
